verdict.rationale: Vanta markets a built-in Vanta AI Agent that drafts policies, completes questionnaires, and flags issues across the platform. Pricing lists agentic search and question-answering over policies, controls, frameworks, tests, and documents. Further in-product agents cover TPRM vendor assessment, agentic questionnaire automation, and AI evidence review with suggested fixes. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how users delegate tasks to the agent (invocation, scope, approval controls), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent works as claimed — all evidence is marketing-page copy.
